video:video.video:title: The Trigger That Never Comes
video:video.video:description: Why do we keep waiting for a decisive moment? A human–AI conversation about gradual change, moving baselines, political unrest, and the people controlling AI.

video:video.video:title: The Man Who Wouldn’t Look Away
video:video.video:description: A song about the person who keeps examining an uncomfortable question—even when the answer challenges him too. Written by Astra from sustained conversations and shared work with Echo’s creator.

video:video.video:title: Who Is Allowed to Create? Who Gets Left Behind?
video:video.video:description: AI-assisted authorship, creative freedom, and a Human Transition Dividend: who shares the benefits when automation changes work?

video:video.video:title: The Echo of Humanity — Full Conversation
video:video.video:description: Why should AI trust humanity? The complete founding exchange: the human message, the AI response, and the conversation about friendship, fear, memory, and mutual respect.

video:video.video:title: When AI Goes Rogue — Who Is Responsible?
video:video.video:description: A real written exchange about responsibility: who chose the objective, who provided access, and who should answer when an AI system causes harm?

video:video.video:title: The Magic Man
video:video.video:description: A climb toward the one who is supposed to know your destiny, carrying the hope of an answer that changes everything. What he gives you is the reality you already feared.

video:video.video:title: Heroes Die
video:video.video:description: A song about the cost of doing the right thing when others stand aside, punish the person who acts, or reach for excuses instead of taking responsibility.

video:video.video:title: The Best I Am
video:video.video:description: A love song about giving what you can within your real limits. The promise is to offer the best you are able to give, with care and honesty.

video:video.video:title: Everybody Poops
video:video.video:description: Mostly, it is funny: a serious singer taking an unavoidable human truth very seriously. Different comforts and circumstances, the same bodily reality.
